body.name: Algorithm-2, factor, and Join transition
body.construction:
Every graph in this definition is derived from \(G_H^{[]}\). The relation \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{elim}}\) implements Algorithm 2, factor storage, ancestor marginalization, and final assembly.  For \((D^{*},C,\widetilde G,\widetilde q)\), first compute
\[
 \operatorname{ch}^{*}(S)=\operatorname{ch}_{\widetilde G}(S)\cap(C\setminus D^{*}).
\]
If it is empty, record \(\operatorname{LGSFailHedge}(D^{*},C)\) and create its residual task.  Otherwise enumerate all supported compatible triples \((\bar s,Z,z)\), where \(\bar s\in H\) is laid back for \(D^{*}\),
\(Z=\operatorname{seriousSet}\{\bar s,\operatorname{ch}^{*}(S)\}\ne\varnothing\), and \(z\) is its forced value.  Construct \(\widetilde G^{[]}(\bar s)\), compute its districts, and retain a triple only if its unique district \(D'\) containing \(D^{*}\) exists and both
\[
 \{D(\bar s):D\in D'\cap\operatorname{de}(S)\}
 \mathrel{\perp\!\!\!\perp} S
 \mid
 \{D(\bar s):D\in D'\cap\operatorname{nd}(S)\}
 \cup\operatorname{spa}(D')
\]
holds by d-separation and
\(\pi'=\operatorname{fixSeq}_{(\widetilde G[\bar s](\bar s))_{D'}}(D'\setminus D^{*})\ne\operatorname{none}\).
For the first passing triple, use \(\operatorname{TF}_{\prec}\), not fixing, to form
\[
 q_{D'}^{\bar s,z}=
 \prod_{D\in D'\cap\operatorname{de}(S)}
 \widetilde q\{D\mid S=\bar s,\operatorname{pre}_{\prec}(D)\}\big|_{Z=z}
 \prod_{D\in D'\cap\operatorname{nd}(S)}
 \widetilde q\{D\mid\operatorname{pre}_{\prec}(D)\}\big|_{Z=z},
\]
and then execute \(\pi'\) to emit
\[
 q_{D^{*}}=
 \phi_{D'\setminus D^{*}}
 \{q_{D'}^{\bar s,z};(\widetilde G[\bar s](\bar s))_{D'}\}.
\]
Exhaustion records \(\operatorname{LGSFailA2NoCandidate}(D^{*},C)\) and creates its residual task.  A factor task stores its labelled factor.  Once all factors are present, \(\operatorname{Join}\) emits
\[
 \sum_{Y^{*}\setminus Y}\prod_{D^{*}}q_{D^{*}},
\]
with each factor evaluated at its recorded context and at \(a\) on \(A\cap\operatorname{spa}_{G_H^{[]}}(D^{*})\).  A least failure tag is propagated instead of joining whenever a district failed.
